mapper.sql: goods_spu . id , goods_spu.`name`, goods_spu.sub_title, goods_spu.spu_urls, goods_spu.`status`, goods_spu.sales_volume, goods_spu.category_first_id, goods_spu.category_second_id, goods_spu.brand_id, goods_spu.create_time, goods_spu.update_time, goods_spu.del_flag, goods_spu.description, goods_spu.enable_specs, goods_spu.stock, goods_spu.freight_type, goods_spu.fixed_freight_price, goods_spu.sales_price, goods_spu.original_price, goods_spu.cost_price
mapper.select: SELECT , goods_spu.attr_tags FROM goods_spu as `goods_spu` WHERE goods_spu.`id` =#{id} AND goods_spu.`del_flag` = '0'

SELECT , goods_category.name AS categoryName, goods_brand.name AS brandName FROM goods_spu AS goods_spu LEFT JOIN goods_category AS goods_category ON goods_spu.category_second_id = goods_category.id LEFT JOIN goods_brand AS goods_brand ON goods_spu.brand_id = goods_brand.id
AND goods_spu.`del_flag` = '0' AND goods_category.`del_flag` = '0' AND goods_spu.`status` = '1'
AND goods_spu.id NOT IN
#{excludeId}
ORDER BY
CASE WHEN goods_spu.category_second_id IN
#{categorySecondId}
THEN 0
WHEN goods_spu.category_first_id IN
#{categoryFirstId}
THEN 1
ELSE 2 END,
CASE WHEN goods_spu.category_first_id IN
#{categoryFirstId}
THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
ORDER BY
goods_spu.sales_volume DESC, goods_spu.create_time DESC, goods_spu.id DESC

SELECT
FROM goods_spu AS goods_spu where goods_spu.id = #{id}
SELECT , goods_spu.attr_tags FROM goods_spu AS goods_spu where goods_spu.id = #{id} AND goods_spu.del_flag = '0' AND goods_spu.status = '1'

SELECT spu.id AS spu_id, sku.id AS sku_id, spu.`name` AS `name`, COALESCE(NULLIF(sku.pic_url, ''), NULLIF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(spu.spu_urls, ',', 1), '')) AS pic_url, sku.stock, sku.sales_price, sku.original_price,
(SELECT NULLIF(GROUP_CONCAT(jt.specs_value_name SEPARATOR '；'), '') FROM JSON_TABLE(IFNULL(sku.specs_arr, JSON_ARRAY()), '$[*]' COLUMNS (specs_value_name VARCHAR(255) PATH '$.specsValueName')) AS jt WHERE jt.specs_value_name IS NOT NULL AND jt.specs_value_name <> '') AS specs_info, spu.`status` FROM goods_spu spu LEFT JOIN goods_sku sku ON sku.spu_id = spu.id AND sku.tenant_id = spu.tenant_id AND sku.del_flag = '0' WHERE spu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND spu.del_flag = '0'
AND spu.`status` = #{status}
AND (spu.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR spu.sub_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY spu.create_time DESC

SELECT spu.`name` FROM goods_spu spu WHERE spu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND spu.del_flag = '0' AND spu.`status` = '1' AND LOWER(spu.`name`) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY spu.sales_volume DESC LIMIT #{limit}
